command: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=/cache/clay-qwen06-native; SRC=$ROOT/llama.cpp; MODEL=$ROOT/models/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf; COMMIT=bb4caa7540188872173c44d161602d9271386413; EXPECT=9465e63a22add5354d9bb4b99e90117043c7124007664907259bd16d043bb031; mkdir -p $ROOT/models; if [ ! -d $SRC/.git ]; then git clone -q --filter=blob:none https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp.git $SRC; fi; git -C $SRC fetch -q origin $COMMIT; git -C $SRC checkout -q --detach $COMMIT; ACTUAL_COMMIT=$(git -C $SRC rev-parse HEAD); test $ACTUAL_COMMIT = $COMMIT; if [ ! -s $MODEL ]; then curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 'https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf?download=true' -o $MODEL; fi; ACTUAL_MODEL=$(sha256sum $MODEL | cut -d ' ' -f1); test $ACTUAL_MODEL = $EXPECT; cmake -S $SRC -B $ROOT/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DGGML_NATIVE=OFF -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=ON >/tmp/qwen06-native-cmake.log 2>&1; cmake --build $ROOT/build -j2 --target llama-cli llama-server >/tmp/qwen06-native-build.log 2>&1; echo PREPARE_NATIVE=PASS; echo llama_cpp_commit=$ACTUAL_COMMIT; echo gguf_sha256=$ACTUAL_MODEL; echo gguf_bytes=$(stat -c %s $MODEL); echo llama_cli_sha256=$(sha256sum $ROOT/build/bin/llama-cli | cut -d ' ' -f1); echo llama_server_sha256=$(sha256sum $ROOT/build/bin/llama-server | cut -d ' ' -f1); for f in $(find $ROOT/build -type f -name 'libllama.so*' | head -5); do sha256sum $f; done; echo '--- cvec api ---'; grep -n 'llama_set_adapter_cvec' $SRC/include/llama.h | head -5; echo '--- tokenize/decode/logits api ---'; grep -En 'llama_tokenize|llama_decode|llama_get_logits_ith' $SRC/include/llama.h | head -20; echo '--- resources ---'; du -sh $ROOT; free -h; df -h /cache
